title: Join strategies and broadcast joins
summary: Choose join strategy based on size, statistics and key distribution.

blocks.text: Choose join strategy based on size, statistics and key distribution.

items: Broadcasting a genuinely small side can avoid shuffling the large side.
Sort-merge join is common for large equi-joins.
A broadcast hint is a request, not a substitute for checking size and plan.
Verify the physical plan and runtime metrics.

blocks.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
joined = facts.join(F.broadcast(dim), "product_id", "left")
joined.explain("formatted")
